dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' structures with high-contrast dark perimeters surrounding light-intensity interior pixels. Perimeters are irregular and exhibit high-frequency pixel-level variance. Gradient transition is sharpest on the dorsal-most edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid dark pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial spaces between major annuli. Several isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters are visible near the posterior terminus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest 'O' structures form an obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of three smaller 'C' and 'O' shapes forms a nearly linear vertical arrangement relative to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct bifurcated visual field characterized by a solid low-intensity anterior region meeting a high-contrast macro-annulated posterior region along a diagonal boundary.
